jev.title: Jev Classification
jev.subtitle: Detect AI writing and classify articles with your own categories.
jev.connectionHint: Connect to Jev System One to analyze article text.
jev.keySaved: Key saved — leave blank to keep it
jev.keyHint: The key is stored on the server and is never returned to the browser.
jev.detectionHint: Changes apply to new classifications. Use Reclassify articles to update existing results.
jev.aiPromptHint: Ask whether the text is AI-generated. A positive answer means AI; a negative answer means Human.
jev.categoriesHint: Category names and descriptions are sent to Jev as classification criteria. Add up to 10 categories.
jev.minTextLengthHint: Articles below this length are skipped. Up to 6,000 characters of plain article text are sent to Jev.
jev.processingHint: When enabled, the worker processes existing and new articles in batches every minute. Reclassification uses the saved settings and sends article text to Jev again.
jev.queued: Articles are pending reclassification. The worker will process them in batches.
jev.requestError: Request failed. Check the settings and try again.
